title: Consumer labels must land atomically
rationale: A partial implementation can display a consumer-facing claim that is unsupported by stored application data.

required_surfaces.description: Schema and migration support for persisted labels
Administrative controls that set the labels

unsafe_partial_state: A false consumer-facing claim may appear configured or public without a trustworthy persisted value behind it.
verification_boundary: Changing every declared surface does not prove correctness, migration safety, accessibility, runtime behavior, or release readiness.
